episodeTitle.en: Building Lovable: $10M ARR in 60 days with 15 people | Anton Osika (CEO and co-founder)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造可爱的产品：15人团队60天内创收1000万美元年营收 | 安东·奥西卡（CEO兼联合创始人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Anton Osika is the co-founder and CEO of Lovable, which is building what they call “the last piece of software”—an AI-powered tool that turns descriptions into working products without requiring any coding knowledge. Since launching three months ago, Lovable hit $4 million ARR in the first four weeks and $10 million ARR in two months with a team of just 15 people, making it Europe’s fastest-growing startup ever. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 安东·奥西卡（Anton Osika）是Lovable的联合创始人兼CEO。Lovable致力于打造一款被称为"最后一块软件"的AI驱动工具——无需任何编码知识即可将产品描述转化为可用的成品。自三个月前推出以来，Lovable仅用15人团队就实现了首周400万美元年营收，两个月内达1000万美元年营收，成为欧洲发展最快的初创公司。您将了解：

title.en: Building Lovable: $10M ARR in 60 days with 15 people | Anton Osika (CEO and co-founder)
title.zh: 打造可爱的产品：15人团队60天内创收1000万美元年营收 | 安东·奥西卡（CEO兼联合创始人）

summary.en: Anton explains Lovable's origin and his philosophy of the “minimum lovable product,” arguing that being loved by users—not just used—is the real growth driver. He hit $10M ARR in two months with just 15 people by obsessing over generalist, multi-skilled hires rather than narrow roles. The conversation covers a live demo, how the team operates and hires, and which skills will matter more or less as AI product-building goes mainstream.
summary.zh: Anton 讲述了 Lovable 的由来，以及他“最小可爱产品”的理念，认为被用户喜爱（而非仅仅使用）才是真正的增长引擎。他用 15 个人在两个月内做到 1000 万美元 ARR，秘诀是痴迷于招“通才”而非窄角色。对话包含现场演示、团队运作与招聘方式，以及在 AI 制造成主流后哪些技能更重要或更不重要。
